title: r128: Update to 1.6.2
body:
Diff: https://github.com/fahickman/r128/compare/6fc177671c47640d5bb69af10cf4ee91050015a1...v1.6.2

I'm not sure why `r128.c` was thought to be pulled from upstream - it's not, it's ours; see the projects' [`README.md`](https://github.com/fahickman/r128/blob/69ba68f1ea666c9136cf56e0105b0cbbe9cd1534/README.md):

```
There is no separate .c file for this library.
```

---

As for the changes since we last updated:

1.6.1 - 2024/12/27
- Fix mingw/clang-cl intrinsics-related compile errors.

1.6.2 - 2026/9/21:
- Fix compile errors around intrinsics on non-MSVC compilers.
